glyph.aetherwastes.touch.desc: The target in front of you (up to 4.5 blocks).
glyph.aetherwastes.projectile.desc: Flies along your gaze up to 24 blocks.
glyph.aetherwastes.zone.desc: A ring around the caster, radius 4.
glyph.aetherwastes.wave.desc: A cone in front of the caster, up to 8 blocks.
glyph.aetherwastes.rune.desc: Places a rune that fires on the first foe.
glyph.aetherwastes.summon.desc: Summons a spirit ally of the school for a minute.
glyph.aetherwastes.forge.desc: Fire and metal. Self: Tempering. Foes: flame. Burns the Scar.
glyph.aetherwastes.flow.desc: Water and blood. Heals allies and wounds, repels foes. Costs hunger.
glyph.aetherwastes.root.desc: Growth and symbiosis. Thorn binds, regeneration, Living Wall, crop growth.
glyph.aetherwastes.silence.desc: Shadow and illusion. Invisibility, blindness, muteness. Paid with Clarity.
glyph.aetherwastes.stone.desc: Sound and stone. Quake, Stone Skin, ore echolocation. Very loud.
glyph.aetherwastes.ash.desc: Souls and memory. Wither, Funeral Bell, echoes of the fallen. Leaves Scar.
glyph.aetherwastes.star.desc: Stars and space. Blink, Recall Mark, time slow. Strong at night.
spell.aetherwastes.name: %s · %s
school.aetherwastes.forge.desc: The Crucible grows strong near fire, forges and lava. Mastery comes from smelting and forging.
school.aetherwastes.flow.desc: The Current is stronger near water and in rain. Every heal costs hunger.
school.aetherwastes.root.desc: Rootwork feeds on grown plants. Mastery comes from harvests.
school.aetherwastes.silence.desc: Silence loves darkness and unease. Paid with Clarity; phantoms become allies.
school.aetherwastes.stone.desc: The Choir sings louder underground. Mastery comes from mining. Very loud.
school.aetherwastes.ash.desc: The Covenant feeds on Soul Essence. Every Echo leaves Scar.
school.aetherwastes.star.desc: The Astrolabe is strong under the night sky and full moon, nearly powerless by day or under a roof.
era.aetherwastes.1.unlocks: Survive: flint, bone, campfire, the first Anchor. No magic yet.
era.aetherwastes.1.gate: Gate: survive the first Aether Tide (5th night of the week).
era.aetherwastes.2.unlocks: Unlocked: your first school of magic (use an Essence glyph), Anchor tier 2.
era.aetherwastes.2.gate: Gate: defeat the Wanderer of Spark and gather 15 Insights.
era.aetherwastes.3.unlocks: Unlocked: a second school, hybrid Essences, Anchor up to tier 4, settlers, Underside portal.
era.aetherwastes.3.gate: Gate: defeat the Wanderer of Resonance and visit the Underside.
era.aetherwastes.4.unlocks: Unlocked: up to four schools, Anchor tier 5, master relics.
era.aetherwastes.4.gate: Gate: defeat the Wanderer of Convergence and reach circle 5 in any school.
era.aetherwastes.5.unlocks: Unlocked: all schools. The road to the Heart of the Rift in the centre of the Underside.
era.aetherwastes.5.gate: Finale: defeat the Last Wanderer at the Heart and choose the world's fate.
gate.aetherwastes.1: Gate: survive the first Aether Tide.
gate.aetherwastes.4: Gate: Wanderer of Convergence %s · highest circle %s/5
gate.aetherwastes.5: Finale: Last Wanderer %s · the choice at the Heart
insight.aetherwastes.reward_glyph: Your insights form knowledge: glyph "%s" (%s insights of "%s").
message.aetherwastes.welcome: You are Awakened. The world is broken and Aether seeps through the cracks. Your goal is shown top-left; the Journal shows the rest.
message.aetherwastes.anchor.info: Anchor tier %s · radius %s · natural pressure %s · load %s/%s
message.aetherwastes.anchor.max: The Anchor is at its highest tier.
message.aetherwastes.anchor.need_era: The next Anchor tier unlocks in the next age.
message.aetherwastes.anchor.upgraded: The Anchor awakens: tier %s, radius %s blocks.
message.aetherwastes.anchor.spawn: The Anchor is now your respawn point.
message.aetherwastes.enchanting_disabled: The enchanting table is dead. In the Wastes, items are engraved at a Slate.
message.aetherwastes.pressure.nausea: The Aether presses on your temples…
message.aetherwastes.vessel.backlash: Backlash! The overfilled Vessel spills Aether.
message.aetherwastes.school.limit: Schools allowed in this age: %s. Pass the age gate.
message.aetherwastes.school.no_magic_yet: Magic still sleeps in you. Survive the first Aether Tide.
message.aetherwastes.slate.empty: The Slate is empty. Form + Essence (two for a hybrid) + up to three Modifiers.
message.aetherwastes.slate.has_form: The Slate already holds a Form.
message.aetherwastes.slate.same_essence: This Essence is already on the Slate.
message.aetherwastes.slate.incomplete: You need at least a Form and an Essence.
message.aetherwastes.spell.echo_none: The Choir hears no ores within %s.
message.aetherwastes.spell.no_ether: Not enough Aether: need %s, Vessel holds %s.
message.aetherwastes.spell.no_mark: No mark in this dimension. Sneak + cast to set one.
message.aetherwastes.spell.rune_placed: The rune is set and waiting.
message.aetherwastes.spell.silenced: You are silenced and cannot cast.
message.aetherwastes.staff.empty: The staff is empty. Inscribe a spell at a Slate.
trauma.aetherwastes.not_needed: You don't need this right now.
nutrition.aetherwastes.malnourished: Malnourished: eat a more varied diet.
nutrition.aetherwastes.stew: The stew gives your body everything it needs.
temperature.aetherwastes.glass_focus: Aether glass focused the sun on you!
mutation.aetherwastes.glass_skin.desc: +4 armor, but explosions hurt twice as much.
mutation.aetherwastes.night_eyes.desc: You see in the dark, but weaken and blink under the sun.
mutation.aetherwastes.roots.desc: Standing on soil heals you, but you move slower.
mutation.aetherwastes.ember_blood.desc: Fire cannot hurt you, but water and rain do.
mutation.aetherwastes.ether_lungs.desc: Your Vessel fills 50% faster, but Clarity fades faster.
mutation.aetherwastes.title: Mutation
forge.aetherwastes.inserted: The workpiece is in. Pump the bellows (use) and take it out (sneak + use) at the right moment.
forge.aetherwastes.tide_trait: The Tide wove a trait into the metal: %s.
forge.aetherwastes.too_cold: The hearth is too cold to repair.
forge.aetherwastes.too_cold_forge: The hearth was cold — the metal is unchanged.
engraving.aetherwastes.no_slots: No free slots (total %s). Forge quality gives more.
engraving.aetherwastes.nothing: Place Essences or Modifiers on the Slate.
engraving.aetherwastes.trophy_slot: The Hunter Trophy opened an extra engraving slot.
ritual.aetherwastes.done.reconciliation: Ritual of Reconciliation: opposed schools no longer dampen each other.
ritual.aetherwastes.done.purification: Ritual of Purification: your body is cleansed.
ritual.aetherwastes.done.underside_porta: An Underside Portal Stone rests on the focus.
ritual.aetherwastes.done.relic: The item became a masterwork relic.
ritual.aetherwastes.done.echo_porter: An Echo Porter now serves your home.
ritual.aetherwastes.done.purifying_salt: Salt and quartz formed a Purifying Obelisk.
ritual.aetherwastes.failed: Wrong pattern! The Aether broke loose as a storm.
ritual.aetherwastes.focus_hint: Place an item on the focus, set 4 pedestals 2 blocks away on each side, and touch it with a staff.
ritual.aetherwastes.pedestal_hint: The pedestal is empty. Place an item on it.
ritual.aetherwastes.need_night: This ritual can only be performed at night.
ritual.aetherwastes.need_pedestals: You need 4 pedestals 2 blocks from the focus.
ritual.aetherwastes.no_wanderer: There is no Wanderer of your age to call.
pulse.aetherwastes.hunter: The World's Pulse answers your tactics: a Hunter resistant to %s has come.
pulse.aetherwastes.hunter_slain: The Hunter falls. Its trophy is the finest engraving material.
pulse.aetherwastes.noise_wave: The noise drew something out of the dark…
siege.aetherwastes.title: Siege of the Anchor!
siege.aetherwastes.subtitle: Enemies: %s
wanderer.aetherwastes.warning: You feel a distant gaze. %s is coming…
wanderer.aetherwastes.defeated: %s is defeated! The age gate draws near.
migration.aetherwastes.herd: Season of %s: a herd crosses your lands.
migration.aetherwastes.predators: Season of %s: a pack of predators is on your trail!
device.aetherwastes.no_anchor: This device needs a nearby Anchor.
device.aetherwastes.overloaded: The Anchor is overloaded — the device fails.
device.aetherwastes.ward_ok: The pylon draws on the Anchor. 4 intact pylons close the ward.
observatory.aetherwastes.full_moon: full moon — the Astrolabe is strong
observatory.aetherwastes.wanderer_near: The stars are restless: a Wanderer may come.
archive.aetherwastes.synced: Journal Archive: %s new entries, %s insights stored.
settler.aetherwastes.name: %s, %s (%s)
settler.aetherwastes.arrived: A settler has come to the Anchor: %s.
underside.aetherwastes.need_era: The portal is silent. The Underside opens in Age III.
underside.aetherwastes.first: The Underside. Aether flows freely here, and buildings without an Anchor dissolve.
rift.aetherwastes.opened: The Tide tore reality: a Rift opened nearby for a day.
rift.aetherwastes.key_opened: The Underside Key opened a trial.
rift.aetherwastes.no_space: No room for a Rift here.
rift.aetherwastes.title: Rift
rift.aetherwastes.subtitle: Defeat the guardians, take the reward, find the exit
rift.aetherwastes.thrown: The Rift closed — you were thrown deep into the Underside!
heart.aetherwastes.announce: The Heart of the Rift waits in the Underside: X %s, Y %s, Z %s.
heart.aetherwastes.choose: The Heart of the Rift beats in your hands. Choose the world's fate:
heart.aetherwastes.already: The world's fate is already decided.
heart.aetherwastes.too_far: The choice is made at the Heart itself.
heart.aetherwastes.guarded: The Last Wanderer guards the Heart.
ending.aetherwastes.heal.desc: Pressure falls, the Scar recedes, fewer monsters. Magic weakens by 30%.
ending.aetherwastes.absorb.desc: You are the new Archivist: all schools, no penalties. The World's Pulse declares war.
ending.aetherwastes.seal.desc: The world freezes, Tides stop. The Underside Key opens endless trials.
second_age.aetherwastes.title: The Second Age
second_age.aetherwastes.subtitle: Cycle %s. The Journal remembers, the world grows stronger.
item.aetherwastes.second_age_seal.confir: The Seal restarts your journey (Age I, schools forgotten, Journal kept). Use while sneaking to confirm.
tooltip.aetherwastes.ether_compass: In hand: Aether pressure, ley lines, world ring and Tide.
tooltip.aetherwastes.ether_compass.study: Sneak + use on an ore or strange block to study it (Insight).
tooltip.aetherwastes.glyph.learn: Use in the air to learn this school.
tooltip.aetherwastes.hunter_trophy: Hold in your off hand while engraving for +1 slot.
tooltip.aetherwastes.nemesis_echo: Use to summon the Echo of your fallen Nemesis for 3 minutes.
tooltip.aetherwastes.staff.empty: Empty. Use on a Slate to inscribe a spell.
tooltip.aetherwastes.underside_key: Use to open a Rift trial (every 5 minutes).
tooltip.aetherwastes.wanderer_shard: Needed for the Underside Portal Stone.
message.aetherwastes.tide_begins: The Aether rises: the Tide has begun!
weapon.aetherwastes.ether_drain: Hits restore 4 Aether to your Vessel
weapon.aetherwastes.sweep: Wide sweep: hurts and slows all nearby foes
weapon.aetherwastes.ember: Sets the target ablaze for 5 seconds
weapon.aetherwastes.backstab: Double damage when striking from behind
weapon.aetherwastes.firebolt: Use: a fan of three fire bolts
weapon.aetherwastes.slam: Use: ground slam that hurls foes within 5 blocks
weapon.aetherwastes.blink: Use: dash 9 blocks through your foes
weapon.aetherwastes.heart: Lifesteal; Use: summon two Heart Guardians
objective.aetherwastes.compass: find a purple Aether Vein underground, mine Shards and craft an Aether Compass
objective.aetherwastes.anchor: place an Anchor, the heart of your base (bones, Shards, campfire, cobblestone)
objective.aetherwastes.school: craft a glyph plate and an Essence glyph of any school, then use it in the air
objective.aetherwastes.inscribe: craft a Glyph Slate and an Aether Staff; place a Form and an Essence, then use the staff on the Slate
objective.aetherwastes.cast: cast a spell: use the staff
objective.aetherwastes.forge: build a Forge Hearth, pump it and forge an item (sneak + use at heat 65–75)
objective.aetherwastes.armor: assemble a full Wastes armor set — every set has a bonus
objective.aetherwastes.gate1: survive the first Aether Tide (5th night of the week)
objective.aetherwastes.gate2_spark: be ready: the Wanderer of Spark comes at night — defeat it
objective.aetherwastes.gate2_insights: gather 15 Insights (%s/15): study ores with the compass, slay new creatures, travel
objective.aetherwastes.gate3_underside: perform the Portal Stone ritual and enter the Underside
objective.aetherwastes.gate4_circle: reach mastery circle 5 in any school (now %s)
objective.aetherwastes.heart: travel to the Heart of the Rift at the centre of the Underside (0, 131, 0)
objective.aetherwastes.free: the world is yours. Explore Rifts and collect every relic

advancements.aetherwastes.compass.title: Aether Sense
advancements.aetherwastes.anchor.title: Safe Harbour
advancements.aetherwastes.glyph.title: First Sign
advancements.aetherwastes.staff.title: Voice of Aether
advancements.aetherwastes.forge.title: Heat and Metal

advancements.aetherwastes.hunter.desc: Slay every new creature of the Wastes
